title: Von Braun tells Edgar Mitchell of his knowledge
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Von Braun tells Edgar Mitchell of his knowledge, about an unknown time at United States (no place named), and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Edgar Mitchell says that he, you know, comes to him and says, you know, he has knowledge of this stuff

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that Edgar Mitchell, an Apollo astronaut who walked on the Moon, told of Wernher von Braun, the German-born rocket engineer who led America's big rockets, coming to him. According to Mitchell as Michels retells it, von Braun said he had knowledge of "this stuff", meaning UFOs. If true, it would mean one of the fathers of the space programme knew something about the subject.
